spanish: Y tomarás cinco cinco siclos al cráneo; en siclo de la santidad tomarás; veinte guerás el siclo.

findings.issue: גֵּרָה is morphologically singular after the cardinal twenty; guerás is plural. The count stays twenty, so the plural is Spanish agreement with veinte.

notes: Doubled cinco, both qal 2ms tomarás, and the verbless twenty–shekel clause stay within the tokens.
